title: Purina Friskies Gravy Swirlers With Flavors of Chicken, Salmon and Gravy Dry Cat Food - 3.15 lb. Bag

reviews.title: Purina Friskies cat food review
reviews.body: My cats absolutely love Purina Friskies Gravy Swirlers! The gravy baked right into the crunchy kibble seems to make it extra appealing, and they come running as soon as they hear me pour it into the bowl. I like that it’s a budget-friendly option while still providing complete and balanced nutrition for adult cats. The chicken and salmon flavors are definitely a hit in our house. If you have picky eaters, this one may be worth trying!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 12, 2026
reviews.author: Kristy Ann

reviews.title: Great Value and a Big Hit with my Cats!
reviews.body: I have a multi-cat household, and this food is a favorite with every single one of them. They all come running when it’s time to eat, and I never have to worry about picky eaters turning their noses up at it. The Gravy Swirlers flavor seems to be especially appealing.The 22-pound bag lasts a while, which makes it an excellent value for the price. With multiple cats to feed, affordability is important, and this food gives me a great combination of quality, quantity, and a price that fits the budget.I’ve purchased it several times and will definitely continue to do so. If you’re looking for a cat food that your cats will actually enjoy without breaking the bank, I highly recommend giving this one a try! 🐾🐈💕
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 17, 2026

reviews.title: Complete Crowd-Pleaser for a Multi-Cat Home!
reviews.body: If you are looking for a dry food that keeps your cats running to the kitchen the second the bowl hits the floor, this 22 lb bag of Purina Friskies Gravy Swirlers is an absolute lifesaver.If you want empty bowls, happy purrs, and a great value for a multi-cat household, you cannot go wrong with this bag. It's an absolute winner!

reviews.author: Eddie

reviews.title: My cat likes it
reviews.body: My cat likes this food, and he hates everything, so that's really saying something.  As my cat has gotten older, he has not only become a lot pickier about his food, but he has also developed a bit of a delicate tummy, and doesn't always keep his dinner down.  But he's holding this one down, and the fact that he likes it means his appetite is improving.I like being able to purchase this food in the 3+ pound size bag, as my cat tends to turn his nose up to dry food if it's been around for too long, even if it's in a sealed container.  I don't mind having to purchase his food a little more often to ensure the freshness, especially since the higher cost-per-ounce is offset by the fact that I don't have any excess stale food to throw out.  Definitely worth the tradeoff.  The food is nutritionally complete, so that makes me happy - my cat couldn't care less, but I sure do.  😹Overall, I think this cat food is working out well for us, and I plan to buy more.

reviews.author: Kathy L.

reviews.title: Not a hit with my cats
reviews.body: There's nothing wrong with this dry food—it just wasn't a hit with my five cats. I thought the gravy swirls would make it especially appealing, but they sniffed it, ate a little, and then went back to their usual food. Every cat has different tastes, and mine can be pretty picky.The kibble looked fresh, the bag arrived in perfect condition, and I like the combination of chicken, salmon, and gravy flavors. It seems like a quality product and would probably be a great choice for cats that enjoy Friskies.Unfortunately, it just wasn't the right fit for my crew, so I won't be purchasing this variety again. If your cats aren't as picky as mine, they may love it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 1, 2026
reviews.author: Katrina

reviews.title: Flavorful, Fun & My Cat Can’t Get Enough!
reviews.body: I recently started feeding my kitty the Purina Friskies Gravy Swirlers Dry Cat Food (Chicken, Salmon & Gravy) and it’s been a huge hit! This blend has quickly become her go-to kibble — and I can see why.🍗 Delicious Mixed Flavors: The combo of chicken, salmon, and gravy-flavored pieces keeps every meal exciting. Even my picky eater finishes her bowl every time and seems genuinely excited at feeding time!🍖 Gravy Swirler Texture: The special gravy-infused pieces add a tasty twist to traditional kibble. They add flavor without making the food messy — just tasty and fun for her to munch.🐱 Great Everyday Nutrition: This dry food hits that sweet spot between flavor and balanced nutrition for daily feeding. My cat stays energized and satisfied between meals.🧴 Good Quality Kibble: The texture is crunchy yet not too hard, perfect for cats of all ages. It doesn’t crumble excessively and mixes well with other foods if you like to add toppers.📏 Ideal for Daily Feeding: The size and shape of the pieces make portioning easy and consistent — great for maintaining a regular feeding routine.Overall, the Purina Friskies Gravy Swirlers Dry Cat Food is a tasty, texture-rich choice that keeps my cat happy and eaten up. If your feline loves variety and savory flavors, this one’s definitely worth trying! 🐾🍗🐟
